verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own AI automations for the bookkeeping steps that make up close. These include AI auto-coding agents, automatic transaction categorization that syncs coded entries to the ERP, real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries, AI-filled receipt memos and categories, and auto-reconciliation of Ramp payments. missing for 10: no explicit month-end close workflow (close checklist, accruals, close-period tracking), no measured close-time reduction, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that close gets faster.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI automations to close my books faster each month

citations.quote: Ramp automatically categorizes transactions based on transaction details, historical information, and your team's direct feedback, then syncs coded transactions directly to your ERP.
Four AI agents handle auto-coding, fraud prevention, approval routing, and automatic payment
Real-time bidirectional sync with ERPs eliminates manual journal entries
Auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe with AI-filled memos and categories
